main_text.p: perat omnem intellectum, sentitur deniq; glo-rificatio & vita aeterna per Christum Jesum.

Ad Philemonem missa fuit Roma per Onesimum servum] Verisimile est,hanc epistolam uno eodemque tempore Romae scriptam & missam cum epistola illa quae ad Colossenses est inscripta. Nam eaedem nominantur in utraq; epistola personae, quarum nomine salutem scribit Apostolus, & per unum eundemque Onesimum servum, tanquam tabellarium, utraque dicitur missa; haec quidem ad Philemonem hominem Colos-sensem Pauli familiarem, illa vero ad universam Colossen-sium Ecclesiam.

page.notes: Printed "adColoffenfes" has no space between "ad" and "Colossenses"; transcribed as printed. Printed "Verisimile eft,hanc" has no space after the comma; transcribed as printed. The "a" in "Roma" in the heading may carry a macron, which is not clear at this scan resolution; written as "Romae" in the text and "Roma" in the heading. The scattered marks in the lower part of the page are show-through or stains and are not transcribed.
